latest.title: A survey on mapping class groups of 3-manifolds
latest.abstract: We survey computations and tools concerning the mapping class group of a compact, oriented, connected 3-manifold $M$. We provide a guide to the literature and sketch proofs for various families of irreducible and geometric 3-manifolds. We also consider JSJ and prime decompositions of 3-manifolds, and consequences for their mapping class groups.
latest.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
latest.workSummary: 系统综述紧定向三流形映射类群的计算方法、主要结果及文献脉络。
latest.breakthrough: 把不可约、几何化及分解情形的工具整理为可检索的统一入口。
latest.limitations: 属于综述性工作，不以新的主定理为核心。
